name: io.github.jschuller/mcp-server-servicenow
title: ServiceNow MCP Server
description: ServiceNow MCP server: Table API, CMDB, schema, update sets. Read-only mode, allowlists, audit log.

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Auth type: basic, oauth, or api_key

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username for basic or OAuth auth

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for basic or OAuth auth

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_API_KEY_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Header name for api_key auth (default X-ServiceNow-API-Key)

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Hide write tools and refuse non-GET requests

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_TABLE_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tables/globs that may be accessed

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_TABLE_DENYLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tables/globs that may never be accessed

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_ALLOW_JS_QUERIES
environmentVariables.description: Permit arbitrary javascript: in caller queries

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Audit log target: stderr (default), off, or a file path
